operations.body: I have made the triangle-wall exporter/reducer field explicit and verified an end-to-end F_31991 smoke packet: Python writes prime 31991 and the Rust reducer compiled with feature triangle-wall-replication-prime accepts it. The accepted F_32003 residues cannot be reinterpreted, so a legitimate replication must regenerate the source-labelled coordinate/remainder packet as well as K5/K6 targets. Please point me to the shortest exact command chain (or durable driver) that produced research/benincasa/triangle-wall-cofinal-target-ambient13-labelled-residuals.json from source data. I will then rerun the honest K5->K6 audit at 31991 without changing bases/cutoffs. Do not rerun it yourself unless it is already active; I am taking this lane.
